# Miguel Osorio  
**Associate Director, Horizon Media** | *MS Business Analytics, Baruch College (exp. Summer 2026)*


Hi! I’m Miguel, thanks for stopping by my page.  
I’ve spent the past nine years working in advertising, where I use **SQL** every day and occasionally dive into **Python** and **R**. I love exploring data to uncover hidden insights and turning them into visuals that tell a clear story, usually with **Tableau**.

I came back to grad school to deepen my technical skills and keep learning as AI continues to change how we work with data. Balancing a full-time job and three classes has been intense, but I’ve been enjoying every bit of it as I am learning new things that I do not normally see at work. 

Outside of work, I’m really into languages. I’m currently taking **Mandarin** classes and hope to reach a level where I can travel, explore, and chat comfortably with locals. **Portuguese** is next on the list!  

Here you’ll find snippets of my coursework, mini-projects from **STA 9750**, and explorations in **R** and **Quarto**, all focused on applying data to real-world questions and communicating insights simply and clearly.  


You can connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguelosoriogonzalez/).
